description.value:
Duration constant

You and your Feral Bond both count as flanking your Marked quarry whenever you are both within 30 feet of it and both able to see it, regardless of where either of you stands relative to the other.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'), resolving what "your Marked quarry" needed. What remains is this card's own Open Question #1, unrelated to the Mark and still unresolved: the only real, buildable piece found is system.attributes.flanking.canGangUp = true (matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/rogue/level-6/gang-up.json), but it is a strictly broader grant than this card describes -- real canGangUp makes flanking-without-opposite-positions work with ANY ally against ANY enemy, at reach (not a fixed 30-ft range), permanently, with no predicate hook to scope it down to "only this one companion, only against my current Mark, only within 30 feet" (it is a single global boolean, not a predicated modifier). Shipping it as-is would silently grant Waywardens a broader, unconditional version of the ability the card text restricts three separate ways, so it stays unshipped pending an owner call: ship the real-but-overbroad canGangUp flag, or leave this fully unbuilt until/unless a predicated version becomes possible.
